lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਰਾਤੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tujh hee man raate ahinis parabhaate har rasanaa jap man re ||2||
lines.translation: My mind is imbued with You, day and night and morning, O Lord; my tongue chants Your Name, and my mind meditates on You. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਰਾਚੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸਾਚੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum saache ham tum hee raache sabad bhed phun saache ||
lines.translation: You are True, and I am absorbed into You; through the mystery of the Shabad, I shall ultimately become True as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਚੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੇ ਸੇ ਕਾਚੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis naam rate se sooche mar janame se kaache ||3||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the Naam day and night are pure, while those who die to be reborn are impure. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar na deesai kis saalaahee tisahi sareek na koee ||
lines.translation: I do not see any other like the Lord; who else should I praise? No one is equal to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: pranavat naanak daasan daasaa guramat jaaniaa soee ||4||5||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of His slaves; by Guru's Instruction, I know Him. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: alakh apaar aga(n)m agochar naa tis kaal na karamaa ||
lines.translation: He is unknowable, infinite, unapproachable and imperceptible. He is not subject to death or karma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਉ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਭਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaat ajaat ajonee sa(n)bhau naa tis bhaau na bharamaa ||1||
lines.translation: His caste is casteless; He is unborn, self-illumined, and free of doubt and desire. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚਿਆਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saache sachiaar vitahu kurabaan ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Truest of the True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪ ਵਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa tis roop varan nahee rekhiaa saachai sabad neesaan || rahaau ||
lines.translation: He has no form, no color and no features; through the True Word of the Shabad, He reveals Himself. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਬੰਧਪ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa tis maat pitaa sut ba(n)dhap naa tis kaam na naaree ||
lines.translation: He has no mother, father, sons or relatives; He is free of sexual desire; He has no wife.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਪਰ ਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: akul nira(n)jan apar para(n)par sagalee jot tumaaree ||2||
lines.translation: He has no ancestry; He is immaculate. He is infinite and endless; O Lord, Your Light is pervading all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat a(n)tar braham lukaaiaa ghat ghat jot sabaaee ||
lines.translation: Deep within each and every heart, God is hidden; His Light is in each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bajar kapaat mukate guramatee nirabhai taaRee laaee ||3||
lines.translation: The heavy doors are opened by Guru's Instructions; one becomes fearless, in the trance of deep meditation. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)t upaai kaal sir ja(n)taa vasagat jugat sabaaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord created all beings, and placed death over the heads of all; all the world is under His Power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev padaarath paavahi chhootahi sabad kamaaee ||4||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, the treasure is obtained; living the Word of the Shabad, one is emancipated. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਚੈ ਭਾਡੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਸੂਚਾਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: soochai bhaadai saach samaavai virale soochaachaaree ||
lines.translation: In the pure vessel, the True Name is contained; how few are those who practice true conduct.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੰਤੈ ਕਉ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: ta(n)tai kau param ta(n)t milaaiaa naanak saran tumaaree ||5||6||
lines.translation: The individual soul is united with the Supreme Soul; Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||5||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਨਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਤਿਉ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu meenaa bin paaneeai tiu saakat marai piaas ||
lines.translation: Like a fish without water is the faithless cynic, who dies of thirst.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰੀਐ ਰੇ ਮਨਾ ਜੋ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tiu har bin mareeai re manaa jo birathaa jaavai saas ||1||
lines.translation: So shall you die, O mind, without the Lord, as your breath goes in vain. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਸੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man re raam naam jas lei ||
lines.translation: O mind, chant the Lord's Name, and praise Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਇਹੁ ਰਸੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਹਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin gur ihu ras kiu lahau gur melai har dei || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, how will you obtain this juice? The Guru shall unite you with the Lord. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t janaa mil sa(n)gatee guramukh teerath hoi ||
lines.translation: For the Gurmukh, meeting with the Society of the Saints is like making a pilgrimage to a sacred shrine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਮਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: athasath teerath majanaa gur daras paraapat hoi ||2||
lines.translation: The benefit of bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage is obtained by the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਤਪੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jogee jat baaharaa tap naahee sat sa(n)tokh ||
lines.translation: Like the Yogi without abstinence, and like penance without truth and contentment,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦੋਖੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tiu naamai bin dehuree jam maarai a(n)tar dokh ||3||
lines.translation: so is the body without the Lord's Name; death will slay it, because of the sin within. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat prem na paaeeai har paaeeai satigur bhaai ||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic does not obtain the Lord's Love; the Lord's Love is obtained only through the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sukh dukh daataa gur milai kahu naanak siphat samaai ||4||7||
lines.translation: One who meets with the Guru, the Giver of pleasure and pain, says Nanak, is absorbed in the Lord's Praise. ||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorath mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਨਿ ਮਤਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too prabh daataa daan mat pooraa ham thaare bhekhaaree jeeu ||
lines.translation: You, God, are the Giver of gifts, the Lord of perfect understanding; I am a mere beggar at Your Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mai kiaa maagau kichh thir na rahaaee har deejai naam piaaree jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: What should I beg for? Nothing remains permanent; O Lord, please, bless me with Your Beloved Name. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat rav rahiaa banavaaree ||
lines.translation: In each and every heart, the Lord, the Lord of the forest, is permeating and pervading.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਗੁਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਿਹਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal gupato varatai gurasabadee dekh nihaaree jeeu || rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the water, on the land, and in the sky, He is pervading but hidden; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is revealed. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਤ ਪਇਆਲ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: marat paiaal akaas dikhaaio gur satigur kirapaa dhaaree jeeu ||
lines.translation: In this world, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in the Akaashic Ethers, the Guru, the True Guru, has shown me the Lord; He has showered me with His Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਨੀ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: so braham ajonee hai bhee honee ghat bheetar dekh muraaree jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: He is the unborn Lord God; He is, and shall ever be. Deep within your heart, behold Him, the Destroyer of ego. ||2||
